claim: The source presentation contrasts repeated monitoring at a fixed location with periodic inspection observations.
approval_or_use_constraint: Use as presentation context only; validate site inspection history.

claim: The source presentation shows a conceptual Wireless UT system comprising sensors, a gateway and data management.
approval_or_use_constraint: Architecture concept only; product, protocol and topology require design approval.

claim: The source presentation shows industrial examples of five sensor mounting arrangements.
approval_or_use_constraint: Examples do not establish suitability for the selected offshore asset.

claim: The source presentation includes stable, linear, variable and episodic trend examples.
approval_or_use_constraint: Examples are explanatory and are not proposed-asset measurements.

claim: The source presentation shows thickness and temperature overlaid and a case-study process change.
approval_or_use_constraint: Supports testing correlation only; does not prove causality.

claim: A source case-study slide separates a baseline robotic scan from later selected point-sensor placement.
approval_or_use_constraint: Screenshot is not the underlying scan dataset; site transfer requires SME confirmation.

claim: The source limitations slide states that sensors are single-point and shows installation preparation considerations.
approval_or_use_constraint: Do not adopt displayed temperature ratings; one unit pair is internally inconsistent.

claim: Target facilities are offshore assets reported as operating for more than 20 years with severe unexpected leaks on insulated and uninsulated piping.
approval_or_use_constraint: Confirm against asset, leak and inspection records before selection.

claim: Refinery examples involving facilities described as more than 40 years old provide precedent for the business problem.
approval_or_use_constraint: Not independently verified as a transcript quotation; do not present as confirmed source speech.

claim: The pilot planning basis is approximately three to five circuits, 24 to 40 locations and nine months, including at least six months of monitored operation.
approval_or_use_constraint: Requires site verification, uncertainty review, cost estimate and engineering approval.

claim: The proposed architecture combines baseline thickness mapping with strategically placed continuous or periodic Wireless UT point monitoring.
approval_or_use_constraint: Baseline coverage, representativeness and location rationale require competent review.

claim: Risk-based prioritization, quality-controlled trending, alerting and decision support should be used to direct qualified inspection and verification.
approval_or_use_constraint: Alerts are review triggers only; independent verification precedes disposition.

claim: Wireless UT point monitoring does not establish unmeasured wall condition or replace spatial mapping.
approval_or_use_constraint: Carry this limitation into every report, dashboard and decision.

claim: The proposed technology does not replace statutory inspection, RBI, FFS, leak detection, approved CUI programs or qualified engineering judgment.
approval_or_use_constraint: Existing obligations and limits remain in force absent separate approval.

claim: Images and model outputs cannot provide measured thickness, corrosion rate, minimum required thickness, remaining life or fitness-for-service acceptance.
approval_or_use_constraint: Enforce in data contracts, model prompts, validation and review workflow.

claim: Presentation financial, savings, service-life and operational-benefit claims are excluded from the pilot business case until independently verified.
approval_or_use_constraint: Use local quotes and measured pilot results; do not transfer presentation values.
